summary: Describes the leaptofrogans URI scheme, which lets applications launch Frogans Player on a given Frogans site. Frogans is a medium for publishing content and services, and Frogans Player is the software to browse Frogans sites. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A special link type that, when you click it, opens a particular viewer program to show a particular site.

questions: uri scheme to launch frogans player
